sections.headline: Planning Your Visit
sections.subheadline: Everything you need to know before joining us for dinner.

items.title: Do you accept walk-ins?
items.description: We hold our bar seats and a portion of the dining room for walk-in guests every evening.

items.title: What is the dress code?
items.description: We suggest smart casual attire. We want you to feel comfortable and at home.

items.title: Can you accommodate gluten-free diets?
items.description: Yes, we offer house-made gluten-free pasta and can adapt most dishes to your needs.

items.title: Is there a corkage fee?
items.description: We allow up to two 750ml bottles per table with a $45 corkage fee per bottle.
